## Purpose of this site

This website provides guidance, templates, and case studies on impact evaluation of
competitive business support programmes. It is intended for managing authorities,
evaluators, and policymakers.

## Responsibility for content

The EuroCOMP Lab maintains this site to improve public access to information on impact
evaluation methods. The aim is to keep this information accurate and up to date, and
errors brought to attention will be corrected.

The information on this site is general in nature and is not professional or legal
advice. It does not necessarily reflect the views of the World Bank Group, its Board of
Executive Directors, or the governments they represent, nor those of the European
Commission or any of its services.

::: {.team-note}
**To confirm**
The exact disclaimer wording should be checked against World Bank external communications
policy, and against any funding agreement in force. This paragraph is a placeholder.
:::

## Links to other sites

This site links to external websites over which it has no control and for which it
accepts no responsibility. A link does not imply endorsement.

## Copyright and reuse

Unless otherwise stated, content on this site may be reused for non-commercial purposes
provided the source is acknowledged and the original meaning is not distorted. Reuse of
material identified as belonging to a third party requires permission from the copyright
holder.

Suggested citation for site content:

> EuroCOMP Lab (2026). *[Page title]*. Available at: [URL]. Accessed [date].
